title: dxn evidence
description: Editor aid for evidence/<root-id>.json; the file name is the root whose subtree the entries cover. Each entry is what an actor recorded for one node in one complete context, pointing to a frame in a file of the repository. The dimensions compiler is the authority: it also checks that nodes exist in this root, that each context is exactly one of the node's contexts, that actors are declared in actors.json, that files exist, that timestamps are real dates, and that entries are unique, which this schema cannot express.

$schema.description: Path or URL of this schema, for editors.

name.description: Non-blank, without leading or trailing whitespace or control characters.

node.description: Id of a node in this file's root.

context.description: One complete context of the node: every dimension, state and shared node's state it has, as "dxn evidence" lists them.

actor.description: The role that recorded it, declared in actors.json.

at.description: ISO 8601 date and time with a time zone.

file.description: Path of the file, relative to the folder that holds .dxn.

frame.description: Id of the frame in that file.

fingerprint.description: A fingerprint of what the frame showed when the entry was recorded: for a pen.dev file, the frame with the components and variables it uses; for any other file, the file's git blob hash, as "git hash-object <file>" prints it. When it differs now, the entry is stale.
